southern-ocean-surf-reef-albany.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore toward 30.26 deg true (NNE), y offshore toward 120.26 deg (x turned 90 deg clockwise); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y)
southern-ocean-surf-reef-albany.crest_note: shallowest crest of the City design table, -1.0 m AHD (about MSL), a design value; the crest is -2.0 m AHD over most of the ridge (assumption A7)

southern-ocean-surf-reef-albany.state_short: As built (rock placed 18 March - June 2025, opened 16 July 2025), plan = Bluecoast final-design outer contour (13,104 m2, default) or the visible rock patch on Esri 2026-01-20 (10,918 m2); heights from City design crest levels over a seabed read from a 2015 design contour plot (LOW confidence). A May 2025 storm move of core rock and the 18 high rocks repositioned in late February 2026 are not modelled.
